chapterTitle: Mi semana de lluvia en Sevilla

extraLinks.label: 📖 Lee la historia: Mi semana de lluvia en Sevilla

blocks.es: 1 · Bajo los arcos (lunes, por la tarde)

blocks.en: Excuse me, can you help me? I'm looking for my flat.

blocks.es: A ver… Sí, está muy cerca, a cinco minutos.
blocks.en: Let's see… Yes, it's very close, five minutes away.
Great! It's pouring with rain.
Yes, it's raining a lot today. Do you have an umbrella?

blocks.es: Sí, pero tengo los zapatos mojados.
blocks.en: Yes, but my shoes are wet.

blocks.es: Quédate un rato aquí, [[c1_bajo_los_arcos|bajo los arcos]].
blocks.en: Stay here for a while, under the arches.
Good idea. Look at the tiles! How cool!

blocks.es: Son de muchos colores. ¿Es tu primera vez en Sevilla?
blocks.en: They're many colours. Is it your first time in Seville?

blocks.es: Sí. Vivo en Madrid, pero esta semana trabajo en Sevilla.
blocks.en: Yes. I live in Madrid, but this week I'm working in Seville.

blocks.es: ¡Qué pena la lluvia! Normalmente hace sol.
blocks.en: What a shame about the rain! It's usually sunny.

blocks.es: [[c1_no_pasa_nada|No pasa nada]]. Quiero ver Sevilla al sol otro día.
blocks.en: Never mind. I want to see Seville in the sun another day.
I'm sure you will. Welcome to Seville!
Thank you very much! See you.

blocks.es: 2 · En el museo (martes por la mañana)

blocks.en: Good morning. One ticket?

blocks.es: Sí, una entrada, por favor. ¿[[c2_cuanto_cuesta|Cuánto cuesta]]?
blocks.en: Yes, one ticket, please. How much is it?
That's six euros.
Here you are. Can I leave my umbrella?

blocks.es: Sí, claro. Déjalo aquí. Está muy mojado.
blocks.en: Yes, of course. Leave it here. It's very wet.
Yes, it's raining again outside.

blocks.es: Por eso hoy hay poca gente.
blocks.en: That's why there are few people today.
Better. Inside it's dry and quiet.
Do you like paintings?

blocks.es: Sí, mucho. Me gusta mirarlos despacio.
blocks.en: Yes, a lot. I like to look at them slowly.

blocks.es: Las salas de pintura están en la [[c2_primera_planta|primera planta]].
blocks.en: The painting rooms are on the first floor.

blocks.es: Perfecto. ¿[[c2_a_que_hora_cierra|A qué hora cierra]] el museo?
blocks.en: Perfect. What time does the museum close?
At eight. Enjoy!

blocks.es: 3 · En el patio (jueves por la tarde)

blocks.en: Good afternoon. Where would you like to sit?

blocks.es: Aquí, bajo el techo. [[c3_a_cubierto|A cubierto]], por favor.
blocks.en: Here, under the roof. Under cover, please.
Very good. What can I get you?

blocks.es: Un café con leche [[c3_bien_caliente|bien caliente]], por favor.
blocks.en: A very hot white coffee, please.
Of course. In this weather, you fancy one.
What a beautiful patio!

blocks.es: Sí. Mira, la lluvia cae sobre el naranjo.
blocks.en: Yes. Look, the rain is falling on the orange tree.

blocks.es: Las naranjas son muy naranjas bajo la lluvia.
blocks.en: The oranges are very orange in the rain.
That's true! Here's your coffee.
Thanks. Can I stay for a while?
Of course. There's no hurry here.

blocks.es: Perfecto. Ya no estoy tan triste con la lluvia.
blocks.en: Perfect. I'm not so sad about the rain any more.

blocks.es: ¡Me alegro! La lluvia también puede ser bonita.
blocks.en: I'm glad! The rain can be beautiful too.

blocks.es: 4 · Junto al río (viernes por la mañana)

blocks.en: Wow! The sun is finally coming out!
Yes! At last it isn't raining today.
Excuse me, could you take a photo of me?
Of course! With the tower behind you?

blocks.es: Sí, por favor. ¿Cómo se llama esa torre?
blocks.en: Yes, please. What's that tower called?

blocks.es: Es la Torre del Oro. Es muy famosa.
blocks.en: It's the Torre del Oro. It's very famous.
It's beautiful! It's golden.
Let's see… Smile! Done!
Thank you so much! What a lovely photo!
You're welcome. Are you going to cross the bridge?
Yes, I want to go to Triana.

blocks.es: Es un barrio muy bonito. ¡Disfruta del sol!
blocks.en: It's a very pretty neighbourhood. Enjoy the sun!
Thanks! Bye!
